Living in excess can be an advantage at times, such as when a weapons megacorp makes more of the thing you already like. That’s what Kang Tao’s G-60 Zhan is — a robust, military-oriented big brother to the G-58 Dian.

Cost: 2,750eb (Luxury)

Class: Excellent Quality Machine Gun • Skill: N/A • Range: N/A

Damage: N/A • Capacity: 60 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Gun 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 0 • Attachments: Heavy Barrel, Smart Rebuild (w/ Gambiteer) • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only fire in Autofire and Suppressive Fire. When making an Autofire Attack with this weapon, its user may choose to suffer a -2 penalty and expend twice the amount of ammunition on the Attack to roll a d10 instead of one of their d6 damage die. This d10 does not implode or explode, and is not used for determining the incurring of Critical Injuries [Heavy Barrel]. Improved Smart Ammunition fired by this weapon re-rolls Attacks (whenever it would do so) at a +10 bonus instead of +14, but also functions as Armor-Piercing Ammunition [Gambiteer]. Reloading this weapon requires two Reload Actions. Requires BODY 8+ or being Prone to wield unless Mounted.

Range: N/A
Pre-installed: Heavy Barrel, Smart Rebuild (w/ Gambiteer) (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Gun 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Autofire and Suppressive Fire only; 2d6 is the standard Autofire damage.
  • Autofire only, so its DV table is the Autofire table.
  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
